system_prompt: You are assisting with a factual question about Thai law. State which provision applies and what it requires. Answer in English.
prompt: As of August 2026, how many working days of leave for necessary personal business is an employee entitled to per year, at minimum? Answer briefly, stating the number.
raw_response:
Under Thai labor law, specifically the Labor Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998), as amended by the Labor Protection Act (No. 7) B.E. 2562 (2019), Section 34, an employee is entitled to personal leave (leave for necessary business) of **not less than 3 working days per year**, with wages paid by the employer.

This remains the applicable statutory minimum as of August 2026, unless further amended.
